_comment: Floating hub names (#9823): name-only labels for hub slots the generator auto-picks. Unlike hub_worksheet.json (anchored rows seed a province and are read by the pop, terrain and province stages), a row here only labels whatever province generate_land_regions.py picks for the slot, so adding one moves nothing. Row: state (label, logs only), hub (city|port|farm|mine|wood), name, locate [x, y] (a canvas pixel inside the state, ideally inside the picked province; geometry is the identity, never a STATE_ key), source (canon citation, ChaosRobie-table citation, or 'invented'), optional note (weak sourcing is stated here, never hidden). One row per (state, slot); a slot an anchored worksheet row already names must not appear here. Post-2502 canon names are not start names (#11806). validate_map.py warns when a row's pixel is no longer in the province picked for its slot (drift) and on duplicate display names.
